messages.splicewire-beam-embed::messages.banner: Only workspace admins can prune or erase retained data.
messages.splicewire-beam-embed::messages.confirm_: You are about to erase :subject. You are erasing the :person, not just their chats — every matching session and its messages are deleted, and the visitor's personal data drops when their last session goes.
messages.splicewire-beam-embed::messages.consent_: Whether each Published Chat lets its transcripts be used for corpus or training. :default There’s no setting for this yet, so new chats are opted out and can’t be opted in.
No published chats yet. New chats default to :opted_out.
No published chats have opted into corpus/training.
:opted of :total published chat opted into corpus/training.|:opted of :total published chats opted into corpus/training.
messages.splicewire-beam-embed::messages.erase_de: A subject-access erasure request. Provide exactly one of a visitor ID or session ID. This erases the :person — the visitor's personal data drops when their last session goes. :irreversible
messages.splicewire-beam-embed::messages.erased: Erased :n session for :subject. This cannot be undone.|Erased :n sessions for :subject. This cannot be undone.
messages.splicewire-beam-embed::messages.footer: Prune previews its blast radius, then runs immediately; erase runs immediately. Both report how many sessions were affected. A browsable per-session list is coming in a future update.
messages.splicewire-beam-embed::messages.irrevers: This is irreversible. There is no undo and no recovery.
messages.splicewire-beam-embed::messages.not_enfo: Retention is :not_enforced — nothing sweeps on a schedule. Sessions past their window persist until you :prune below. Default window is :window.
messages.splicewire-beam-embed::messages.posture_: Retention is a per-Published-Chat window that is snapshotted onto each session when it starts.
messages.splicewire-beam-embed::messages.provide_: Provide exactly one of a visitor ID or session ID.
messages.splicewire-beam-embed::messages.prune_de: Delete every embed session (and its messages) past its retention window. A visitor's personal data drops once their last session is gone.
messages.splicewire-beam-embed::messages.prune_pr: :n session past their window would be removed by a prune right now.|:n sessions past their window would be removed by a prune right now.
messages.splicewire-beam-embed::messages.pruned: Pruned :n session past their retention window.|Pruned :n sessions past their retention window.
messages.splicewire-beam-embed::messages.windows_: No published chats yet. New chats default to a :window window.
